plan.summary: FEAT-LIW Chunk C (Dashboard UI). Standalone /settings/lead-intake page in Backend Dashboard + 6 tenant-scoped JWT-auth'd endpoints + DB migration 022 for audit history + landing_api_key NOT NULL relaxation. Four UI cards + FlowWarningBanner + AuditLogTimeline compose the page. ApiKeyManagerCard implements the single-key-per-tenant model already in the tenant_landing_settings schema (active + 24h grace old), with 'Generate-once + copy modal' UX — the plaintext key is shown exactly once on generate/rotate, masked as 'liw_live_****abcd' thereafter. FieldMapEditorCard uses form-rows (source-field text input -> canonical-field dropdown) plus a 'paste sample payload, extract sources' helper; strict validation on save (phone + consent REQUIRED, unknown canonical BLOCKED, empty source BLOCKED). DryRunPreviewCard POSTs sample payload to a backend endpoint that reuses the EXACT FieldMapResolver + PhoneE164Normalizer + consent-check code path as real intake but short-circuits before any DB write or flow enqueue. FlowWarningBanner renders a page-load banner when the configured welcome_flow_slug has no matching active chatbot_flows row (resolves the INV-AT-069 silent-skip observed on prod smoke). AuditLogTimeline shows the last 50 audit entries from the new liw_audit_log table (action + user + relative time + before/after summary). All writes emit an audit_log insert within the SAME transaction as the settings UPDATE (avoids the CQ2 fire-and-forget silent-drift pattern). row_version optimistic concurrency via updated_at — mutations require the caller to pass the observed updated_at; 0-rows returned from the UPDATE = conflict (409 INV-BE-113). Six endpoints under /api/v1/tenant/landing/* (JWT auth, tenant_id from JWT claim only, no caller-supplied tenant_id to prevent IDOR). Migration 022 creates liw_audit_log(id, tenant_id, user_id, action, before_json, after_json, created_at) + composite index on (tenant_id, created_at DESC) AND relaxes tenant_landing_settings.landing_api_key NOT NULL -> NULL (needed for revoke semantics; PL/pgSQL DO block makes the ALTER idempotent). FindByApiKeyAsync gains 'AND landing_api_key IS NOT NULL' guard so revoked rows never match. Error codes: INV-BE-113 (concurrent modification 409), INV-BE-114 (required canonical missing 400), INV-BE-115 (unknown canonical 400), INV-BE-116 (dry-run invalid payload 400). Applied lessons: arch/errors.md user_message LITERAL match (lesson 2026-04-16), XML doc describes runtime behavior (lesson 2026-04-18), no null-forgiving operators (lesson 2026-04-18 x2), schema-citation comments on every new repo method (lesson 2026-04-18).

plan.interview_notes: 8 interview decisions (2026-04-18 23:50 -> 2026-04-19 00:00): (1) API key UX = Generate-once + copy modal (single key per tenant with 24h grace rotation; revoke clears both keys + sets active to NULL). (2) Field map UI = form-rows with source-field text input -> canonical-field dropdown + sample-payload paste auto-detect helper. (3) Dry-run = backend endpoint /dry-run reusing real resolvers (no client-side duplicate logic -> no drift risk). (4) Page placement = standalone /settings/lead-intake route; entry via new card in existing SettingsPage; NO new sidebar icon (Layout bloat prevention, matches Zoho's integrations-card-link pattern). (5) Flow rename warning = reactive banner on /settings/lead-intake (page-load check); proactive flow-editor-save hook deferred to v2. acceptance_criteria.criterion: Migration 022 creates liw_audit_log(id BIGSERIAL PK, tenant_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES tenant_registry(tenant_id), user_id INT NULL, action VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, before_json JSONB NULL, after_json JSONB NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()) + index idx_liw_audit_log_tenant_created ON (tenant_id, created_at DESC) + GRANT ALL ON liw_audit_log, liw_audit_log_id_seq TO invekto (production role, per lesson 2026-04-18 GRANT audit). Migration is idempotent: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS + CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS. SAME migration also relaxes tenant_landing_settings.landing_api_key NOT NULL -> NULL via a PL/pgSQL DO block that checks pg_attribute.attnotnull before ALTER COLUMN DROP NOT NULL (idempotent). Canonical schema copies: new arch/db/liw-audit-log.sql mirrors the table DDL; arch/db/tenant-landing-settings.sql updated comment header noting Chunk C nullable relaxation + revoke semantics. Action values allowed (enforced at application layer): 'apikey.rotate', 'apikey.revoke', 'fieldmap.save', 'welcome_slug.change' (last one reserved future-use; Chunk C does not mutate welcome_slug).

Six backend endpoints registered under /api/v1/tenant/landing/* — ALL JWT-auth'd via Backend's existing JwtAuthMiddleware; tenant_id is extracted EXCLUSIVELY from the JWT claim (no caller-supplied tenant_id parameter, IDOR prevention per CQ9 precedent). (a) GET /settings -> 200 TenantLandingSettingsDto { tenant_id, masked_active_key (nullable when not yet initialized or revoked), masked_old_key?, old_expires_at?, field_map, welcome_flow_slug, dup_window_days, flow_status { resolved_slug, exists, flow_id?, flow_display_name? }, updated_at (row_version), created_at, has_active_key (bool) }. Returns a sentinel envelope for tenants with no row yet (auto-row-create is lazy on first rotate). (b) POST /apikey/rotate -> 200 RotateApiKeyResponse { active_plaintext, masked_old, old_expires_at, row_version }. Auto-creates the settings row on first call (no expected_row_version required for first-time create). Subsequent rotations require If-Match: <updated_at> header -> 409 INV-BE-113 on mismatch. Moves current active -> old + sets old_expires_at = NOW() + '24 hours'::interval; generates new active via ApiKeyGenerator. (c) POST /apikey/revoke -> 204. Requires If-Match. Sets landing_api_key = NULL and landing_api_key_old = NULL + clears old_expires_at. (d) PUT /fieldmap -> 200 { field_map, row_version }. Body: { field_map, expected_row_version }. Validates via FieldMapValidator -> 400 INV-BE-114 / INV-BE-115 with first error message + errors[] array in envelope. (e) POST /dry-run -> 200 DryRunResponse { resolved_fields, warnings, would_upsert, would_trigger_welcome, phone_e164?, consent_ok }. Request body: { source_slug, payload (JsonElement), field_map_override? }. field_map_override lets the UI preview UNSAVED drafts. No DB write, no flow enqueue. (f) GET /audit?limit=50 -> 200 { entries: LiwAuditEntryDto[] }. Newest-first. limit clamped to [1, 200]. user_display = 'User#{user_id}' or 'Sistem' when user_id is null.

ApiKeyGenerator.cs — cryptographically secure key generator. Implementation: RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(48) -> Convert.ToBase64String -> URL-safe transform (+ -> -, / -> _, trim =) -> 'liw_live_' prefix + truncate final length to 64 chars total. Prefix enables at-a-glance identification in logs/configs (reserves 'liw_test_' for a future sandbox mode). RotateApiKeyAsync retries ONCE on PostgreSQL 23505 unique-violation (uq_tls_api_key collision — astronomically unlikely but defensive per CQ2 observability guidance) then surfaces 500 INV-BE-001 with a structured log line.

FieldMapValidator.cs — pure validation helper returning ValidationResult { is_valid, errors: { field_name, error_code, message }[] }. Canonical allowlist (static readonly): 'name', 'phone', 'email', 'consent', 'utm_source', 'utm_medium', 'utm_campaign', 'utm_content', 'utm_term', 'referer', 'metadata'. Rules: (a) at least one mapping to 'phone' canonical required — INV-BE-114 msg 'Telefon alani zorunlu (en az bir satirda canonical=phone olmali)'. (b) at least one mapping to 'consent' canonical required — INV-BE-114 msg 'KVKK onay alani zorunlu (en az bir satirda canonical=consent olmali)'. (c) NO canonical value outside the allowlist — INV-BE-115 msg 'Tanimsiz canonical alan: \'{field}\'. Gecerli alanlar: {allowlist}'. (d) NO empty source-field string — INV-BE-114 msg 'Kaynak alan adi bos birakilamaz'. (e) NO duplicate canonical target EXCEPT 'metadata' (multiple sources may map to metadata for arbitrary extras; name/phone/email/consent must be unique canonical targets) — INV-BE-114 msg 'Canonical alan \'{canonical}\' birden fazla kaynak alana atanamaz'. Validator returns errors (not throw). LiwSettingsService.UpdateFieldMapAsync maps is_valid=false to 400 with errors[0] as envelope primary error + errors[] as supplementary array (arch/contracts envelope convention).

TenantLandingSettingsRepository gains 4 new virtual methods matching FindByApiKeyAsync/FindByTenantIdAsync precedent. (a) EnsureRowExistsOrCreateWithKeyAsync(tenantId, initialActiveKey, ct) — INSERT with ON CONFLICT (tenant_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING updated_at, or SELECT-updated_at when row exists; initial landing_field_map = '{}'::jsonb; initial landing_api_key = @initialActiveKey (NOT NULL satisfied). (b) RotateApiKeyAsync(tenantId, newActive, graceUntil, expectedRowVersion, ct) — UPDATE tenant_landing_settings SET landing_api_key_old = landing_api_key, landing_api_key_old_expires_at = @grace, landing_api_key = @new, updated_at = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = @tid AND updated_at = @expected RETURNING updated_at. 0 rows -> conflict. (c) RevokeApiKeyAsync(tenantId, expectedRowVersion, ct) — UPDATE SET landing_api_key = NULL, landing_api_key_old = NULL, landing_api_key_old_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = @tid AND updated_at = @expected RETURNING updated_at. 0 rows -> conflict. (d) UpdateFieldMapAsync(tenantId, fieldMapJson, expectedRowVersion, ct) — UPDATE SET landing_field_map = @json::jsonb, updated_at = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = @tid AND updated_at = @expected RETURNING updated_at. 0 rows -> conflict. Additionally: FindByApiKeyAsync gains 'AND landing_api_key IS NOT NULL' guard so revoked rows never match. All methods accept optional NpgsqlConnection parameter (default: open own connection) to participate in an external transaction. Schema-citation comment on every new method cites arch/db/tenant-landing-settings.sql + migration 022.

LiwAuditRepository.cs — NEW class separate from TenantLandingSettingsRepository (single-responsibility + future audit growth room). Two virtual methods. (a) InsertAsync(tenantId, userId?, action, beforeJson?, afterJson?, conn, ct) — INSERT INTO liw_audit_log (tenant_id, user_id, action, before_json, after_json) VALUES (...). ALWAYS takes an externally-owned NpgsqlConnection (no default) because audit writes must run inside the caller's transaction. (b) ListAsync(tenantId, limit, ct) — SELECT id, action, before_json::text, after_json::text, created_at, user_id FROM liw_audit_log WHERE tenant_id = @tid ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT @limit. Own connection (read-only, no transaction needed). Schema-citation comment cites arch/db/liw-audit-log.sql + migration 022.

AutomationFlowLookupRepository.cs — NEW minimal Backend repo. Single method: LookupActiveFlowByNameAsync(tenantId, flowName, ct) -> (FlowId int, FlowName string, DisplayName string)? or null. SELECT flow_id, flow_name, display_name FROM chatbot_flows WHERE tenant_id = @tid AND flow_name = @name AND is_active = true LIMIT 1. Used EXCLUSIVELY by LiwSettingsService.GetSettingsAsync to populate flow_status in the GET response (avoids a second UI roundtrip). Read-only; no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE surface. Schema-citation comment acknowledges microservice isolation policy: the chatbot_flows table lives in the shared PostgreSQL; Backend READs this table READ-ONLY matching the same pattern Chunk B's AutomationRepository.GetFlowByNameAndTenantAsync uses (read access to a peer service's operational table is the established project pattern; writes would require an HTTP hop).

LiwSettingsService.cs — NEW application service orchestrating the 6 endpoints. Methods: GetSettingsAsync(tenantId, ct), RotateApiKeyAsync(tenantId, userId, expectedVersion?, ct), RevokeApiKeyAsync(tenantId, userId, expectedVersion, ct), UpdateFieldMapAsync(tenantId, userId, fieldMap, expectedVersion, ct), DryRunAsync(tenantId, request, ct), ListAuditAsync(tenantId, limit, ct). Returns typed result objects (Success<T> / Conflict / ValidationFailed / NotConfigured) so the endpoint layer maps to HTTP responses without exception-as-control-flow. Each mutating method follows the pattern: (1) validate input, (2) open connection, (3) BEGIN, (4) perform settings UPDATE, (5) InsertAsync on LiwAuditRepository with same connection, (6) COMMIT (or ROLLBACK on any failure), (7) return updated projection. DryRunAsync: NO transaction (read-only); validates payload JSON -> resolves via FieldMapResolver (with optional field_map_override) -> runs PhoneE164Normalizer -> checks consent -> assembles DryRunResponse. FieldMapResolver from Chunk A receives a minor additive extension (new overload Resolve(payload, fieldMapOverride) that does not touch persistence context) — existing signature UNCHANGED, so Chunk A/B call sites keep working. No null-forgiving operators anywhere. DI registration: LiwSettingsService as Singleton in Program.cs (matches LeadIntakeService Singleton pattern).

Dashboard App.tsx gains a lazy-loaded route <Route path='/settings/lead-intake' element={<LeadIntakeSettingsPage />} /> under the existing ProtectedRoute+Layout wrapper. No sidebar entry added to Layout.tsx (Layout bloat prevention). Entry is via a new 'Lead Kaynaklari' card on SettingsPage.tsx that navigates to /settings/lead-intake — SettingsPage.tsx modification is PURELY additive (new card appended below existing cards; no existing layout/markup reshuffle). document.title = 'Invekto AI - Lead Kaynaklari' on page mount.

LeadIntakeSettingsPage.tsx container — fetches settings on mount (GET /api/v1/tenant/landing/settings) and renders children: FlowWarningBanner (only when flow_status.exists=false), ApiKeyManagerCard, FieldMapEditorCard, DryRunPreviewCard, AuditLogTimeline. Loading state = centered spinner; error state = inline error banner with Retry button. Shared state (settings object + row_version + unsaved draft field_map) held in useState/useEffect — matches ZohoStageMappingPage.tsx pattern, NOT Zustand (avoids store bloat for a localized page). row_version is threaded into every mutation request header (If-Match). On 409 response, the page automatically refetches settings + toasts 'Ayarlar baska bir sekmede degistirildi, son hali yuklendi' + preserves any unsaved fieldmap draft rows so the tenant can retry the save. SWR-style refetch on every successful mutation keeps the AuditLogTimeline fresh.

ApiKeyManagerCard.tsx — three visual states. (A) Not-initialized (masked_active_key=null AND created_at=null): primary 'Yeni API Key Olustur' button; on click -> POST /apikey/rotate -> NewKeyCopyModal opens with plaintext + copy-to-clipboard button + X close icon (per Q's rule 'no Cancel text button in modals'). Modal clears plaintext from React state on close. (B) Active (masked_active_key non-null): masked display 'liw_live_****abcd' + rotated_at relative-time + 'Yenile' button + 'Iptal Et' button. Yenile -> confirm dialog 'Mevcut key 24 saat boyunca calismaya devam edecek, yeni key olusturulacak. Devam edilsin mi?' -> POST /rotate -> NewKeyCopyModal. Iptal Et -> confirm dialog 'Bu tenant artik lead alamayacak. Devam edilsin mi?' -> POST /revoke -> toast 'API key iptal edildi'. (C) Grace period (old_expires_at in future): additionally shows 'Eski key: liw_live_****xxxx — {N} saat icinde gecersiz' inline chip. Clipboard API failure path (iframe/insecure context): textarea + document.execCommand('copy') fallback with user-visible confirmation.

FieldMapEditorCard.tsx — editable table rows { source_field: string, canonical_field: string }. Columns: 'Kaynak Alan (Landing Form)' | 'Invekto Canonical' | '' (remove button). Canonical dropdown populated from types/leadIntake.ts CANONICAL_FIELDS constant (mirrors FieldMapValidator allowlist). Required canonical fields (phone, consent) are rendered with a red asterisk in the dropdown; when neither 'phone' nor 'consent' is present across any row, the 'Kaydet' button is disabled with a tooltip 'En az bir satir canonical=phone ve bir satir canonical=consent olmali'. Unknown canonical legacy data -> red border + inline 'Tanimsiz alan — duzeltin' message. 'Kaynak Yapistirma Yardimi' button -> modal with textarea; on submit, JSON top-level keys are extracted and empty rows pre-filled (DOES NOT overwrite existing non-empty rows). Dirty flag tracks unsaved edits; window.beforeunload prompt fires if dirty. Save -> PUT /fieldmap with If-Match; on 409 the card absorbs the fresh server map but preserves the unsaved dirty rows (manual merge by tenant).

DryRunPreviewCard.tsx — two-pane layout: left editable JSON payload textarea, right read-only results panel, top 'Dry Run Calistir' button. The card reads the CURRENT unsaved field_map from parent page state and passes it as field_map_override in the POST body so preview reflects draft edits without requiring a save. Results panel sections: resolved_fields 2-column table; 'Normalized phone: +905551112233 (OK)' or 'Phone parse basarisiz' in red; 'Onay alani: OK' green check / 'Eksik' red X; warnings[] as a yellow bullet list; 'would_upsert' + 'would_trigger_welcome' as colored chips (green=true / gray=false). Invalid payload JSON -> inline textarea border+message before the network call. 'Dry Run Calistir' is disabled while a request is in flight.

FlowWarningBanner.tsx — renders TOP banner ONLY when settings.flow_status.exists=false. Banner copy TR: 'Uyari: Welcome akisi `{resolved_slug}` tenant'in aktif chatbot_flows listesinde bulunamadi. Yeni lead kayitlari olusacak ama welcome mesaji tetiklenmeyecek.' + secondary line '`{resolved_slug}` adli bir flow'u Flow Builder'da aktif hale getirin veya Ayarlar uzerinden welcome slug'ini degistirin.' + [Flow Builder'a Git] outline button linking to /flow-builder. Banner is dismissible per-session via X close icon but re-mounts on page refresh (so the tenant does not permanently hide a live config gap).

AuditLogTimeline.tsx — right-rail timeline (or bottom full-width on narrow viewports). Fetches GET /audit?limit=50 on mount and after every successful mutation elsewhere on the page. Each entry rendered as { action_label_tr, user_display, relative_time, summary_line }. Action labels: apikey.rotate -> 'API key yenilendi', apikey.revoke -> 'API key iptal edildi', fieldmap.save -> 'Alan eslesmesi guncellendi', welcome_slug.change -> 'Welcome akisi degisti' (future). Summary line computed client-side: apikey diff displays 'Eski: ***abcd -> Yeni: ***wxyz' (extracted from before_json/after_json last 4 chars); fieldmap diff displays '{N} satir -> {M} satir' + '+{added} / -{removed}' counts. Clicking an entry expands into a <details> block with raw before_json / after_json (developer-friendly, not primary UX).

arch/contracts/lead-intake.json gains a 'dashboard_endpoints' section listing all 6 endpoints (path, method, request shape, response shape, error codes, concurrency model note). arch/errors.md adds four new codes with literal TR user_message strings matching FieldMapValidator messages (per lesson 2026-04-16 user_message LITERAL match rule): INV-BE-113 'Ayarlar baska bir sekmede degistirildi, son hali yuklendi.' (409); INV-BE-114 'Alan eslesmesinde zorunlu canonical alan eksik veya hatali.' (400); INV-BE-115 'Tanimsiz canonical alan.' (400); INV-BE-116 'Dry-run payload gecersiz (JSON format hatasi).' (400). ErrorCodes.cs synchronized with matching constants. Chunk A cross_channel_attribution section and Chunk B wa_direct_internal_endpoint section remain UNTOUCHED (additive-only modifications).

Build PASS across Invekto.Shared + Invekto.Backend (Dashboard Vite build triggered via existing Invekto.Backend.csproj pre-build target). Zero regression in Chunks A/B runtime paths: (a) FindByApiKeyAsync additive 'AND landing_api_key IS NOT NULL' guard is semantically equivalent to current behavior for non-NULL keys; (b) LeadIntakeService.IntakeAsync + IntakeWaDirectAsync code paths UNCHANGED (FieldMapResolver gets a NEW overload but the existing signature keeps its exact behavior); (c) Zoho/Flow/Knowledge pages UNCHANGED. Migration 022 runs idempotently against production — CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS + CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS + PL/pgSQL DO block gating the ALTER COLUMN DROP NOT NULL on pg_attribute.attnotnull. Zero Chunk C-introduced warnings on build.

spec_acceptance_criteria.description: Field mapping config JSONB (landing_field_map) -> source field -> canonical field
Phone E.164 normalize + duplicate check (son 30g window, tenant-scoped)
Source tag auto-assign (source_slug path param) + UTM passthrough (JSONB intake_metadata)
Consent flag required (source form'da opt-in checkbox, field mapping'te zorunlu alan)
WA direct (wa.me) inbound -> eger lead yoksa otomatik create (profile name + phone)

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Single-key-per-tenant model (active + 24h grace old) instead of multi-key labeled management
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Matches existing tenant_landing_settings schema (PK tenant_id, one row per tenant). Multi-key would require a tenant_landing_api_keys table + migration. Q explicitly chose 'Generate-once + copy modal' (single-key UX). Revoke endpoint covers the 'stop accepting leads' scenario.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: no CQ flag on 'why not a keys table?'. Spec scope explicitly chose single-key; multi-key deferred if tenant demand surfaces.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: landing_api_key DB column relaxed from NOT NULL to NULL in migration 022 to support revoke semantics
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Pure soft-delete flag would still leave the key usable via FindByApiKeyAsync; sentinel values (e.g., 'REVOKED_...') pollute uq_tls_api_key + require sentinel-aware lookup code. NULL is the cleanest 'key not set' signal + FindByApiKeyAsync 'AND landing_api_key IS NOT NULL' guard prevents accidental matches.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: CQ11 may probe schema change scope; migration 022 gates the ALTER in a PL/pgSQL DO block (idempotent via pg_attribute.attnotnull check).

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Dry-run endpoint reuses the real FieldMapResolver + PhoneE164Normalizer + consent-check code path instead of duplicating validation client-side
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Eliminates drift risk between preview and real intake (Q rejected the 'both client + backend' option for exactly this reason). Performance: dry-run is a per-interaction human-speed action; ~10-20 ms backend roundtrip is well within UX budget.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: no CQ flag on code reuse; LiwSettingsService.DryRunAsync calls the same collaborators LeadIntakeService.IntakeAsync uses.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: row_version optimistic concurrency via updated_at (timestamptz) rather than a dedicated version INT column
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: updated_at is already on the schema and naturally monotonic; a version INT requires another migration + triggers. Client treats updated_at as an opaque string (no date-parsing) so sub-millisecond precision drift is not a correctness concern. Same-millisecond collision for the same tenant is astronomically unlikely at human mutation speed.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: CQ6 may probe race conditions; mitigation is 'UPDATE ... WHERE updated_at = @expected RETURNING updated_at' — 0 rows = conflict. Client retries after refetch.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: No sidebar entry for /settings/lead-intake; entry via a new card on the existing SettingsPage
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Q chose 'standalone page' over 'SettingsPage tab' AND 'IntegrationsPage card' — meaning own route, not nested. Layout sidebar already has 12+ items; adding 'Lead Kaynaklari' as top-level displaces higher-priority entries. Settings-drill-down via a card link matches the Zoho pattern (sub-routes are reached via IntegrationsPage cards, not sidebar).
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: no CQ flag on UX discoverability — SettingsPage card link is a conventional settings-drill-down pattern.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Audit insert happens in the SAME transaction as the underlying settings UPDATE, not in a fire-and-forget async call
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Fire-and-forget audit is a known CQ2 silent-drift pattern — audit-miss becomes possible while the main change succeeded. Same-transaction means an audit-insert failure rolls back the main change; user retries; audit is consistent. Performance cost is a single-row INSERT (~1 ms intra-connection) which is acceptable for a settings page.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: CQ2 WOULD flag absence of transactional audit; plan proactively keeps them in the same transaction.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: LiwAuditRepository is a SEPARATE class, not a method on TenantLandingSettingsRepository
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Single-responsibility: tenant_landing_settings repo speaks to ONE table; liw_audit_log is a distinct table with different access patterns (append-only write, time-range read). Future audit growth has room without bloating the settings repo.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: no CQ flag — textbook SRP.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Strict field map validation with block-save + inline error surfaces, not warn-only
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Q explicitly chose strict. Underlying Chunk A intake already enforces phone + consent at runtime — warn-only at save time would create a 'saved but invalid' config state that silently drops real leads. Strict at save = runtime invariant maintained, no surprise 400 at lead arrival.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: no CQ flag — UX pattern is 'fail fast, visible'.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Backend reads chatbot_flows directly (via AutomationFlowLookupRepository) rather than calling an Automation HTTP endpoint
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Chunk B precedent: TriggerWelcomeFlowJob in Automation reads the same table. Read-only cross-service DB access is the established project pattern; an HTTP hop would add ~20-50 ms latency to every settings-page GET without a tangible isolation benefit for READS. Writes would still go through HTTP (not applicable here — this is read-only flow_status lookup).
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: CQ9 or Q-category verification question may probe microservice isolation. Mitigation documented in AC7 + in the repo's schema-citation comment.

verification_questions.question: Migration 022 relaxes tenant_landing_settings.landing_api_key from NOT NULL to NULL via a PL/pgSQL DO block that checks pg_attribute.attnotnull before ALTER COLUMN DROP NOT NULL (idempotent). Rollback scenario: if the migration is reverted, any existing NULL-key row would violate the re-added NOT NULL constraint — the rollback SQL must either purge NULL rows or set a sentinel. Does the migration need a companion rollback.sql documenting the clean-up, or is the forward-only convention (per arch/db/migrations/ precedent — 021 has no rollback counterpart) sufficient?

row_version threading via updated_at — if Q rotates a key from tab A while simultaneously saving a field_map from tab B (both with the original version), one wins (409 on the other). The loser must refetch. UX impact: the loser's local draft field_map is discarded on full refetch unless we merge. Plan AC10 preserves the unsaved-dirty rows on 409 + refetches server state + toast. Is 'preserve dirty rows + overwrite clean state' acceptable, or should the client perform an explicit field-by-field merge of server-new-rows with local-dirty-rows?

FlowWarningBanner calls AutomationFlowLookupRepository.LookupActiveFlowByNameAsync from WITHIN Backend — a READ of a table (chatbot_flows) that Automation owns operationally. CLAUDE.md says 'servisler arasi dogrudan referans YASAK — Shared uzerinden iletisim'. Policy interpretation: shared PostgreSQL table READS are allowed cross-service (Chunk B precedent: TriggerWelcomeFlowJob in Automation reads the SAME table; plan AC7 read-only crossing mirrors that pattern). Should READ be allowed under this rule, or does it demand an HTTP endpoint on Automation for Backend to call?

DryRunPreviewCard sends an UNSAVED draft field_map as field_map_override in POST /dry-run. Threat model: JWT-auth'd + tenant-scoped, so override only affects the caller's own response (no cross-tenant leak). Should dry-run apply the SAME strict FieldMapValidator rules as PUT /fieldmap (block unknown canonical + missing required), or skip validation to let tenants inspect 'what would the resolver do with a bad map?' for diagnostic purposes?

Audit diff_summary is computed client-side in AuditLogTimeline.tsx from before_json/after_json. If a second UI consumer (e.g., Chunk D super-admin view) also needs audit display, it would re-implement the diff logic. Should diff summary be server-side (a computed VIEW or a response transform in GET /audit) to avoid duplication, or is client-side for v1 acceptable (YAGNI + matches how every other Dashboard component structures presentation)?

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: Every degradation path is observable: (a) settings mutations use RETURNING updated_at to detect 0-rows-as-conflict (409 INV-BE-113 explicit response); (b) audit insert in the same transaction means audit-insert failure rolls back the entire mutation (user retries; consistent state); (c) FlowWarningBanner explicitly RENDERS when flow_status.exists=false (not silently absent); (d) dry-run JSON parse failure returns 400 INV-BE-116 with envelope message (not empty response); (e) ApiKeyGenerator unique-violation retries once then surfaces 500 INV-BE-001 with structured log; (f) Dashboard 409 path triggers refetch + toast (the tenant sees state diverged, not silently-lost change); (g) clipboard API failure falls back to execCommand + confirm (user sees success or manual-copy instruction, never a silent no-op).

aha_moments.user_pain: Tenant admin rotates the landing API key on Dashboard without realizing their landing page HTML still embeds the old key; form submissions start 401-ing; tenant notices 'leads stopped coming in' only after 30-60 minutes and opens a support ticket.
aha_moments.suggestion: 24h grace period on rotate (existing schema: landing_api_key_old + landing_api_key_old_expires_at) — old key keeps working for 24 hours with a prominent UI chip 'Eski key: liw_live_****abcd — {N} saat icinde gecersiz'. ApiKeyManagerCard renders this chip immediately after rotate.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Tenant rotates, sees the grace chip, realizes 'I need to update the landing page within 24h', does so in minutes — zero lost leads, no support ticket.

aha_moments.user_pain: Tenant copies field_map values from an existing working setup on another landing page, pastes them into Invekto, saves — but they forgot 'consent' canonical field. Chunk A intake returns 400 on the first real lead submission; tenant has no idea why it's broken.
aha_moments.suggestion: Strict FieldMapValidator at SAVE time — tenant CANNOT save a field_map missing 'phone' or 'consent'. Inline error 'En az bir satir consent canonical alanina map edilmeli' + red asterisk marks required targets in the dropdown. Save button disabled with tooltip until resolved.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Tenant realizes at save time (not at first failed lead), adds the 'kvkk_onay' -> 'consent' row, saves — first real lead works end-to-end.

aha_moments.user_pain: Tenant built a 12-field mapping for a Meta Lead Ads form. They're unsure the mapping is correct. Validating today requires submitting a real test lead via the ads platform — 5-10 minutes per iteration and pollutes the real leads table.
aha_moments.suggestion: DryRunPreviewCard — tenant pastes the JSON payload Meta would POST, clicks 'Dry Run Calistir', sees resolved canonical fields + phone E.164 normalization + consent check + would_trigger_welcome in <1 second. No DB write, no lead row, no test pollution.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Tenant pastes sample payload, sees 'phone_e164: +905551112233 (OK); consent_ok: EKSIK (source field kvkk payload'da yok)' and fixes the Meta form field name in 30 seconds.

aha_moments.user_pain: Ops engineer investigating 'tenant reports welcome message not sending'. Today the only signal is INV-AT-069 log lines in Automation (observed on prod smoke validation). Correlating Dashboard-visible config to those logs requires SSH + grep.
aha_moments.suggestion: FlowWarningBanner renders at page-load when the configured welcome_flow_slug has no matching active chatbot_flows row. The tenant sees the problem BEFORE a real lead arrives. Ops engineer visiting the tenant's Dashboard (super-admin impersonation, existing flow) sees the banner immediately.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Ops engineer visits /settings/lead-intake, sees the red banner, tells tenant 'your slug welcome_default is not an active flow — rename a flow to welcome_default or change the slug'; resolved in 2 minutes instead of 30 of log-grep.

aha_moments.user_pain: Pilot onboarding call: the prospect asks 'can I see what happens when a lead fills the form BEFORE we go live?'. Today the answer is 'check the API docs and craft a curl request'.
aha_moments.suggestion: DryRunPreviewCard is demo-ready: paste a canned sample payload, click Run, see instant structured response. Works without a real landing page, without test leads, without any setup beyond the field_map.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Prospect watches Q paste a mock JSON, click Run, sees 'Ahmet Yilmaz, +905551234567, consent OK, would_trigger_welcome: true' — realizes 'this is configurable without code, I can debug my own integration'. Deal advances in the same call.
